test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

They said, "We are watching a movie."

options.text: They said that they had watched a movie.
They said that they were watching a movie.
They said that they watched a movie.
They said that they are watching a movie.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that they were watching a movie.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"We are watching" becomes "they were watching"**
